page: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-480GB-2xB200 is a GPU-accelerated server designed for high-performance computing and machine learning workloads. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8570 processor with 48 physical cores and 48 vCPUs running at 2.0 GHz, this KVM-based instance features a shared CPU allocation. The hardware configuration is highlighted by two NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs providing a total of 384 GB of VRAM, paired with 480.0 GB of system memory. No local storage is bundled with this instance, meaning external storage solutions must be attached.

Performance benchmarks indicate exceptional capabilities, particularly in multi-threaded and memory-intensive operations. The server achieves top-tier status in Passmark CPU scores, CPU physics tests, and extended instruction sets, alongside top-tier multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth also ranks in the top tier, while multi-core stress-ng performance and write bandwidth are rated as strong. For database and memory-caching tasks, the instance delivers top-tier database operations and strong Redis SET performance.

In terms of AI and machine learning, the dual Blackwell B200 GPUs deliver top-tier prompt processing speeds and strong text generation speeds for LLM inference. The qualitative cost efficiency of this server is defined by its high resource density, combining massive GPU memory with a substantial system memory footprint to handle large-scale models without the overhead of multi-node clustering. This makes it highly suitable for deep learning training, LLM inference, complex scientific simulations, and high-throughput data processing.
